view.name: Home
view.description: Portal home with hero banner, browse-all button and grid of category tiles with icons.

regions.label: Light gray top navbar with wordmark and Datasets / Organizations / Categories links
Light-gray rounded jumbotron with H1, intro paragraph, blue 'Browse all datasets' button and circular map-dot image
'Browse by Category' heading and 7x2 grid of outlined icon tiles linking to category pages

evidence.note: Whole tile is a link; black noun-project icon above label, 1px #dee2e6 border, 6px radius

evidence.quote: Westbrook Open Data Datasets Organizations Categories
evidence.note: Simple site-wide top navbar with three fixed destinations
Circular map with colored dots is a static decorative img ('Example homepage hero image'), not interactive
No search box on the homepage

structure.layout: single-column Bootstrap homepage: top navbar, rounded jumbotron hero with text left and circular image right, then a 7-column grid of category tiles; empty footer

aesthetics.typography: system-ui throughout (Bootstrap default stack) for headings, body, nav and buttons; all weight 400
aesthetics.typeScale: Light-weight display H1 48px, lead paragraph 24px, section heading 28px, brand and button 20px, body/nav/tile labels 16px; hierarchy by size only, no bold

notes: Stock Bootstrap 5 JKAN template with no custom theming: #f8f9fa navbar and jumbotron, #0d6efd primary button, outlined tiles with #dee2e6 borders and 6px radius. Category tiles use black filled Noun Project pictograms of inconsistent visual weight and size (e.g. small coins vs. large theater masks), centered above 16px labels. Hero image is a circular crop of a light basemap scattered with translucent colored data dots. Footer (contentinfo) is empty. No search on homepage.
